---
# JID title page: title <= 120 characters, sentence case (this one is 89). The subtitle
# that said "Short version, formatted to JID limits" was an internal note and is gone.
title: "Cutaneous HPV is transcriptionally inactive in skin and carcinoma but productive in warts"
# Authors and affiliations are rendered by _titlepage.qmd, which gives the numbered
# affiliations JID asks for. The pandoc docx byline duplicated the names on the page
# and is suppressed (TP comment 0, 2026-11-02): keep author metadata out of the YAML
# so the writer emits no byline. ORCiDs are listed in the back matter.
date: last-modified
bibliography: references.bib
csl: journal-of-investigative-dermatology.csl
crossref:
  custom:
    - kind: float
      key: suppfig
      reference-prefix: "Figure S"
      space-before-numbering: false
      latex-env: suppfig
    - kind: float
      key: supptbl
      reference-prefix: "Table S"
      space-before-numbering: false
      # captions above the table, as in the eluring manuscripts; tbl-cap-location
      # does not reach the docx writer for a custom float type
      caption-location: top
      latex-env: supptbl
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
    number-sections: false
    embed-resources: true
    theme: cosmo
    fig-cap-location: bottom
    tbl-cap-location: top
  # Co-author copy styled like the eluring manuscripts: Times New Roman 11 pt, double
  # spacing, continuous line numbering, bold 12 pt headings. reference.docx is copied
  # from eluring (adult_centenarian/reports/assets). After rendering, run
  # `python3 docx_table_rules.py manuscript_short.docx` for the ruled tables.
  docx:
    reference-doc: reference.docx
    toc: false
    number-sections: false
    fig-cap-location: bottom
    tbl-cap-location: top
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Reproducible numbers: results_models.R re-fits M1/M2/M3 from the pipeline
# outputs and builds `stats`; _helpers.R adds formatters + table builders.
# Every quoted figure below is rendered inline (`r ...`) from these.
library(tidyverse); library(here); library(knitr)
invisible(capture.output(source(here("manuscript/results_models.R"))))
source(here("manuscript/_helpers.R"))
# Bayesian posterior summaries are precomputed by manuscript/bayesian_models.R
# (MCMC, ~40s) and read here, so the render itself stays fast/deterministic.
bayes <- readRDS(here("manuscript/bayes_summary.rds"))
bget  <- function(m) as.list(bayes[bayes$model == m, ])
```
